samples.name: Banner Keeper
samples.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a hand-painted fantasy chess boardgame character sheet, 1536x1024 PNG with genuine alpha transparency.
Reference image 1 (knight) and reference image 2 (maester) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: borrow their crisp dark edges, soft painted volume, broad legible forms, slightly exaggerated character anatomy and polished hand-painted boardgame illustration. Do not copy either identity, costume or equipment. Do NOT copy their background.
Create TWO full-body versions of the SAME new character, identical pose, anatomy, facial identity and scale: ivory army version LEFT, charcoal army version RIGHT. Slight three-quarter view facing toward the RIGHT on both halves, not mirrored. Palette must be about 85% warm ivory for the left character and 85% charcoal grey for the right character, with a tiny muted gold accent, subdued natural skin and hair. No bright colour accents.
Character: BANNER KEEPER, a small round adult female travelling herald. Warm reliable adult face, braided hair coiled above the ears, rounded short capelet over a practical belted tunic, sturdy short legs and both complete boots clearly visible. She holds a perfectly straight upright pole in one hand. Its upper end carries a SHORT broad forked banner, with a clean visible negative-space gap between banner and body; the banner shape is a strong vertical silhouette. The banner matches the ivory or charcoal army palette and carries only one small plain muted gold circle. Her other arm extends a clear relaxed open palm. No weapon or shield.
Layout: each whole character and all her equipment fit entirely in its own half of the sheet. Generous transparent margins and a wide clean transparent central gutter, no overlap. Highest pole/banner point near y=120 and boot baseline near y=960. All feet, banner edges, pole ends and fingertips included without cropping. Strong readable silhouettes that still look good as small game pieces.
Transparent empty background only. No ground, no plinth, no base, no cast shadow, no environment, no glow, no vignette, no background colours, no simulated checkerboard. No text, lettering, labels, crown symbols or crosses. No goggles, wrench, large backpack, weapon, shield or tower helmet. Not a realistic 3D render, not anime. Exactly two figures: the two army colour versions of this same Banner Keeper.
samples.notes: Complete figure and equipment; top of pole is approximately 18px from top rather than requested 120px. Gold trim occupies more area than a tiny accent. Pair pose and identity match.

samples.name: Javelin Runner
samples.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a hand-painted fantasy chess boardgame character sheet, 1536x1024 PNG with genuine alpha transparency.
Reference image 1 (knight) and reference image 2 (maester) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: borrow their crisp dark edges, soft painted volume, broad legible forms, slightly exaggerated character anatomy and polished hand-painted boardgame illustration. Do not copy either identity, costume or equipment. Do NOT copy their background.
Create exactly TWO full-body versions of the SAME new character, identical pose, anatomy, face and scale: ivory army version LEFT, charcoal army version RIGHT. Slight three-quarter view facing toward the RIGHT on both halves, not mirrored. About 85% of each figure's clothing and equipment uses its army palette: warm ivory left, charcoal grey right. Tiny muted brass accent only, subdued natural skin and dark hair. No bright colour accents.
Character: JAVELIN RUNNER, a lean adult male elf with swept-back hair and clearly pointed ears. A light short split coat, light fitted armour, uncovered forearms and practical boots. No long cape, no hood, no helmet. Exactly THREE javelins rise in a compact clearly separated fan behind one shoulder, carried in a simple narrow back harness; clearly recognizable short throwing spears with small leaf-shaped metal spearheads, no fletching. One additional SHORT javelin is held low and roughly horizontally in his front hand, ready to throw. Compact spear length, complete spear point and rear end. These are javelins, never arrows or a bow. His other hand balances the posture naturally.
Pose: a balanced forward-leaning poised step with both feet complete and easy to read, graceful running readiness without extreme action. The light armour and forward posture communicate FAST; the fan of javelins communicates RANGED. His silhouette and identity must be distinct from the horse-helmet armoured Knight reference, and from a female hooded wrist-bow Archer.
Layout: each whole character and ALL his javelins fit entirely in its own half of the sheet, no crossing the centre. Generous transparent outer margins and a wide clean transparent central gutter. The highest point of the javelin fan should be around y=120; both feet reach a common baseline around y=950. Keep each version's overall occupied height and width equal. Complete boots, fingertips, pointed ears, all four javelin points and ends; no cropping.
Empty genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background only. No ground, no plinth, no base, no cast shadow, no environment, no glow, no vignette, no coloured backdrop, no simulated checkerboard. No text, lettering or labels. Not a realistic 3D render and not anime. Exactly two figures: the ivory and charcoal versions of this same Javelin Runner.
samples.notes: Complete figure and equipment; exactly three stored javelins and one held horizontally. Held javelin has small metal butt spike. Armour somewhat heavier than light brief. Top spear margin approximately 22px rather than requested 120px. Pair pose and identity match.

edit.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached paired Javelin Runner sheet. Make ONE targeted costume correction while keeping the exact same elf character, face, hair, ears, anatomy, stance, pose, composition, camera, scale, painted style and ivory-left/charcoal-right pair.
Replace the large hard plate shoulder pauldrons with close-fitting soft cloth short sleeves and a thin fitted leather shoulder yoke. Remove all layered metal shoulder plates and exaggerated shoulder width. Replace the hard chest breastplate with a close-fitting soft cloth tunic; folds and seams make the fabric obvious. Remove the metal knee plates and metal shin greaves, replacing them with close-fitting cloth trouser legs and simple thin leather shin wraps above the existing boots. The result is a lean lightly equipped runner in cloth and flexible leather, with no bulky plate armour anywhere.
Preserve the dominant ivory tunic and trousers on the left, charcoal tunic and trousers on the right, and small muted brass fittings. Keep the existing narrow leather straps and javelin harness. Preserve both hands exactly, both complete boots and feet exactly, and all four javelins per character exactly: three stored in the fan behind the shoulder and one low horizontal javelin. Keep the position, size and count of all javelins unchanged.
Keep the existing crisp dark edges, soft painted volume and hand-painted fantasy boardgame illustration. Same transparent 1536x1024 canvas, complete equipment within each half, clear transparent central gutter. Preserve genuine alpha transparency. No background, ground, base, shadow, glow, checkerboard, text, labels, extra items, extra figures or other changes.
edit.notes: Final edit removes the bulky metal shoulder, chest, knee and shin armour, replacing it with cloth and thin leather. Face, hair, pointed ears, posture, colours, all four javelins, hands and feet are visually preserved. No third attempt.
